definitions.explanation: The place someone is heading to or planning to go.
Where someone has gone or can be found.

examples.japanese: {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}を{教|おし}えてください。
{彼|かれ}の{行|ゆ}き{先|さき}が{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I don't know where he went.

examples.japanese: {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}を{決|き}めていない。
examples.english: I haven't decided on a destination.

notes:
COMPOUND: {行|ゆ}く (to go) + {先|さき} (ahead, destination)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}を{決|き}める (decide on a destination)
- {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}を{知|し}らせる (inform of whereabouts)
- {行|ゆ}き{先|さき}が{分|わ}からない (don't know where [someone] went)

SIMILAR TERMS:
- {目的地|もくてきち} (destination - more formal)
- {行方|ゆくえ} (whereabouts, direction)
- {帰|かえ}り{先|さき} (return destination)
